Landing.metaTitle: Al-Rawi · Every stone has a narrator
Landing.metaDescription: A bilingual AI guide to Saudi Arabia's UNESCO World Heritage sites: At-Turaif, Hegra and Historic Jeddah. Explore 3D monuments and get answers that cite their sources.
Landing.heroEyebrow: Saudi Arabia's UNESCO World Heritage, retold
Landing.heroBody: Al-Rawi is a bilingual AI guide to At-Turaif, Hegra and Historic Jeddah. Ask in Arabic or English, explore 3D monuments, and get answers that cite their sources.
Landing.sitesBody: Each site opens in the 3D workspace with its own questions, landmarks and sources.

siteStory.diriyah: Mud-brick palaces on the edge of Wadi Hanifah, where the First Saudi State was governed.
siteStory.hegra: 111 Nabataean tombs carved into sandstone, Saudi Arabia's first World Heritage site.
siteStory.jeddah: Coral-stone tower houses and wooden rawashin at the Red Sea gateway to Makkah.

Landing.howBody: From a question to a cited answer, a knowledge map and a narrated conversation.
Landing.step1Body: Type or speak a question in Arabic or English, or tap a suggested inquiry for the site you are viewing.
Landing.step2Body: Answers arrive like a manuscript, with numbered citations you can open to read the source excerpt.
Landing.step3Body: Turn any answer into a knowledge graph of people, places and periods, and fly the camera to each node.
Landing.step4Body: Generate an editable two-voice conversation about the site and listen to it narrated.
Landing.trustBody: Heritage knowledge has to be right. Al-Rawi is designed around primary sources and transparency.
Landing.trustCitedBody: Citations link back to the document they came from, so experts can verify every claim.
Landing.trustArabicBody: Right-to-left layout, Arabic typography and Arabic answers are first-class, not a translation layer.
Landing.trustHostBody: The archive, database and AI pipeline can be deployed in your own environment.
Landing.sourcesLabel: Designed to work with primary sources from
Landing.sourceDarah: King Abdulaziz Foundation for Research and Archives (Darah)
Landing.audienceAuthorityBody: Turn nomination dossiers and conservation reports into an accurate, citable guide for the public.
Landing.audienceOperatorBody: Give visitors a memorable bilingual companion before, during and after their visit.
Landing.audienceVisitorBody: Explore the sites in 3D, ask anything and learn from the sources themselves.
Landing.footerBody: No account or setup needed. The demo archive works straight away.

Tour.siteBody: Pick At-Turaif, Hegra or Historic Jeddah. The camera flies to the monument and the suggested questions change.
Tour.personaBody: The Storyteller tells history as a story. The Scholar answers with archival precision.
Tour.askBody: Type a question in Arabic or English, or tap one of the suggested inquiries.
Tour.citeBody: Every answer lists its sources. Tap a citation to read the excerpt and open the original record.
Tour.waiting: The Oracle is composing an answer…
